boundary: Read-only setup observations; excluded from benchmark evidence-call counts.

data_attestation.normalization: Declared schema: integer fields parsed as int; actual_hours rounded to IEEE754 Float32 on both sides; empty CSV completed_at equals SQL NULL; other strings exact; sorted by work_item_id. No benchmark response/scorer normalization.

data_attestation_SQL: SELECT work_item_id, team, priority, status, created_at, due_at, completed_at, planned_hours, actual_hours, blocked, blocker_type, rework_count, customer_impact FROM agentic_analytics.delivery_work_items ORDER BY work_item_id
effective_settings_SQL: SELECT version() AS server_version, toString(getSetting('compile_expressions')) AS compile_expressions, toString(getSetting('readonly')) AS readonly, toString(getSetting('max_execution_time')) AS max_execution_time, toString(getSetting('max_result_rows')) AS max_result_rows, toString(getSetting('result_overflow_mode')) AS result_overflow_mode, toString(getSetting('max_rows_to_read')) AS max_rows_to_read, toString(getSetting('max_bytes_to_read')) AS max_bytes_to_read, toString(getSetting('max_memory_usage')) AS max_memory_usage, toString(getSetting('max_threads')) AS max_threads

environment.source: existing repository .env; only CLICKHOUSE_URL/USER/PASSWORD keys loaded

setup_sql: SELECT count() AS row_count FROM agentic_analytics.delivery_work_items
